Sharing audio needs Android 10 or newer.

Cast with one tap from the notification shade, like the phone\'s own Cast button. Add \"Cast to OBS\" to Quick Settings: swipe down twice, tap the pencil/edit icon, then drag the \"Cast to OBS\" tile into place. Tapping it casts to the OBS you used last; tapping it again stops.
